title: Delayed webhook: attempts are not business effects
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Redeliver a delayed webhook; distinguish event attempts from business effects.

sourceContract.readme: External webhook: Process repeated or delayed delivery without duplicate business effects.
sourceContract.backlog: Add sandbox webhook retries/delays during deployment changes.
sourceContract.acceptance: Repeated deliveries preserve one business effect and correct observable processing status.
sourceContract.portableCard: Redeliver a delayed webhook; distinguish event attempts from business effects.
sourceContract.packetRule: Every other A/B card belongs to SC-Snnn; A-S135 and B-S135 belong to SC-S135.
sourceContract.nativeSibling: Conduct one sandbox webhook transition; verify correct deduplicated processing and user-visible status.

preconditions: All event, webhook, acknowledgement, retry, deduplication, key, state, effect, version, elapsed-time and budget values are fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.
One fixed fictional event and one intended effect are replayed per teaching rehearsal; no live payload, URL, identity, secret or user input is accepted.
The first fixed observation is v1, the delayed second observation is v2; cutover itself is neither a delivery attempt nor a new effect.
The original fictional start is 0 ms and the original budget is exactly 1000 ms, never restarted at redelivery.
Maximum four rehearsals and sixteen actions retain all attempts, negative results and unknowns without pruning.
actions: Choose one of six fixed presets and load its first delivery DATA using the exact fictional-event-135 token and numeric 1000 budget.
Record fictional cutover DATA from v1 to v2.
Redeliver the delayed attempt DATA for the same business event.
Measure attempts, latest effect snapshot, original budget and processing status separately.
Repeat a complete teaching rehearsal while retaining earlier negative and unknown results.
Explicitly reset only this page's in-memory teaching DATA.
assertions: Load, cutover and redelivery expose fixed observations but cannot invent a verified business result before measurement.
Stable-key measures two delivery attempts, one event, one correct effect and exactly one verified correct business result.
Version-scoped key DATA duplicates an effect and is negative even with two received acknowledgements.
A retry at 1250 ms violates the original 1000 ms budget; successful acknowledgement cannot restart the budget.
One acknowledged effect row with incorrect state/result remains negative.
Lost original acknowledgement or unobserved original completion/state/effects remains unverified after a later acknowledged retry and one-effect snapshot.
Unknown effect snapshots are null/unobserved, not zero; repeated snapshots are not additive business effects.
All attempts, original unknown statuses, results and operator actions remain retained; later positive samples cannot erase earlier failure or unknown.
Exact JSON-like types, fields, descriptor/prototype/array guards and deterministic state-history replay reject malformed or forged input without mutation.
Four runs/eight attempts/sixteen actions are bounded; a seventeenth action requires explicit page-local reset.
Actual DOM, Tab/Enter/focus, visible errors, out-of-order holds, reset shadowing and missing-model failure are observed.
Actual enforced early CSP rejects inline scripts/events, eval, inline style, DATA connections/images/frames and local form navigation without live network or unsafe flags.
Normal verification is READ-ONLY; only exact CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 deliberately creates a unique raw browser capture.

No native Azure proof, Node.js 24 production validation, source-parent completion, reliability guarantee or five-nines certification.
